description: Two dimensional continuous cellular automaton on a 32 by 32 grid, where each cell holds a value from 0 to 1, read by up to sixteen play heads

params.text: Moves the play head across the columns; a right click on the grid sets it to the column clicked
Moves the play head across the rows; a right click on the grid sets it to the row clicked
Multiplies the cell value, which runs from 0 to 1, before it reaches the output, 0 to 10
The cell value a gate needs to pass, 0 to 1
Fills the grid with random values
The spread of the random values a random fill writes, 1 to 10
Runs one generation of the automaton
Lets the Gen input run generations; while it is off only the Gen button does
Winds the grid back to the last saved state
Picks the rule applied to the averaged neighbourhood of each cell, one of seven arithmetic functions of that average and the Param knob
The number the rule works with, 0 to 1

inputs.text: Places a play head on a column for each of its channels, the 32 columns spread over 0-10V, added to the CvX knob and wrapped around
Places a play head on a row for each of its channels, the 32 rows spread over 0-10V, added to the CvY knob and wrapped around
Adds to the scale, one channel per play head, one for one in volts
Adds to the offset, one channel per play head, one for one in volts
A rising edge runs one generation while On is lit
A rising edge winds the grid back to the last saved state
Fills the grid with random values while the voltage here is above 1V
Sets that number, 0-10V across the whole range, and overrides the Param knob while patched
A rising edge saves the grid as it stands, for a reset to come back to

outputs.text: The cell value under the play head, multiplied by the scale and shifted by the offset, one channel per play head
Carries 10V on a play head's channel while the cell under it is above the threshold

notes: every cell comes up at zero: press Rnd, or send a trigger to the Rnd input, to fill the grid before the play heads have anything to read
menu: Avg Type — picks how a cell's neighbourhood is averaged: Wighted, Normal, or NWSE only, which counts only the four cells sharing an edge
Color Mode — draws the grid in Grey, Palette 1, Palette 2 or Palette 3
Clear — sets every cell to zero
